note: levels of the synthesised shots, and the two published figures used. One constant is calibrated (the rifle anchor); the pistol levels follow from the simulated muzzle conditions.

calibration.anchor: about 140 dB peak for a .22 calibre rifle (cited in a firearm suppressor study, PMC8588962). Its measuring position is not stated; taken here as the shooter's ear

bracket_check.published: Flamme et al.: instantaneous peak levels 1 m to the shooter's left ranged from 149 to 167 dB across 15 recreational firearms (as summarised in CDC stacks 211059)
bracket_check.comment: a .22 pistol should sit near the bottom of the bracket; CCI Quiet-22 falls just below or near its lower edge, as a reduced load should

subsonic.note: all three loads leave the 102 mm barrel below the speed of sound (ballistics.json), so there is no ballistic crack in any shot
